Their presence has repeatedly stirred resentment among residents over issues such as noise, aircraft crashes and the conduct of personnel. The 1995 rape of a 12-year-old Okinawan girl by three US servicemen sparked mass protests. Saturday's killing could complicate Takaichi's efforts to [USN:L1N455098 TEXT:"relocate some Marines"] from the busy Futenma air base to a more remote facility at Henoko. Opponents want the troops moved out of the prefecture. Okinawa, which is 100 km (60 miles) from Taiwan at the closest point, is viewed by Tokyo and Washington as key in deterring potential military aggression from China.

item.title: Kirill Kaprizov, Wild overcome slow start to blow past Bruins
item.description: Kirill Kaprizov scored a pair of goals, and the Minnesota Wild pulled away for a 4-1 win over the Boston Bruins on Saturday night in Saint Paul, Minn.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Kirill Kaprizov scored a pair of goals, and the Minnesota Wild pulled away for a 4-1 win over the Boston Bruins on Saturday night in Saint Paul, Minn. Quinn Hughes tallied a goal and an assist for Minnesota, which won its second game in a row to start the season. Wild captain Jared Spurgeon also scored a goal. Tanner Jeannot scored the lone goal for Boston, which was playing on short rest after defeating the Winnipeg Jets one night earlier. Wild goaltender Jesper Wallstedt stopped 26 of 27 shots to earn the victory. Bruins goaltender Michael DiPietro allowed three goals on 29 shots in his season debut. DiPietro stuffed Wild forward Matt Boldy on a breakaway but allowed a pair of power-play goals. The Bruins opened the scoring less than two minutes into the game. Jeannot set up toward the left side of the crease, took a short pass from Mark Kastelic and fired the puck into the back of the net for his first goal of the season. Boston held that lead for over a full period before Minnesota pulled even with 13:49 to go in the second period. The Wild capitalized on a power-play opportunity when Maxim Shabanov got the puck behind the net and passed it to Kaprizov, who scored on a snap shot. The Wild delivered on the power play once again to grab a 2-1 lead with 7:32 remaining in the second period. Ryan Hartman won a faceoff and Bobby Brink redirected the puck to Hughes, who skated to the high slot and unleashed a wrist shot through traffic that beat DiPietro. Minnesota made it 3-1 with 16:36 left in the third period. Spurgeon fired a long shot that deflected off the skate of Bruins defender Nikita Zadorov and into the net. Kaprizov capped the scoring when he punched in a backhanded shot for an empty-net goal with 1:01 to go. The play gave him three goals in two games to start the season. -Field Level Media

item.title: テニス＝ルバキナ、世界ランク1位としての初戦で逆転負け
item.description: ［３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［３日　ロイター］ - テニスの中国オープン（ＯＰ）は３日、北京で試合を行い、女子シングルス２回戦で世界ランキング１位のエレーナ・ルバキナ（カザフスタン）が初戦敗退を喫した。

この日が初戦となった第１シードのルバキナは、アリーナ・チャラエワ（アルメニア）と対戦し、第１セットは６─３で奪ったものの、続くセットを４─６、３─６で落として逆転負け。９月の全米ＯＰで優勝し、キャリア初の世界ランク１位となったルバキナだが、トップに浮上した後の最初の試合で敗れた選手としては、大坂なおみに次ぐ史上２人目となった。

ＷＴＡランキングは１９７５年に初めて発表されたが、ＯｐｔａＡｃｅによると、それ以降で世界ランク１位の相手に逆転勝ちを収めた選手では、今回のチャラエワ（１１８位）が最もランクの低いプレーヤーだという。

ルバキナは「間違いなく、今日は非常に厳しい試合だった。全米ＯＰで優勝してからいろいろなことがあった。睡眠や回復の機会をあまり持てなかった。アリーナをお祝いしたい。彼女は素晴らしい試合をした」と話した。

item.title: ＮＢＡ＝ピストンズ、デューレンとの契約延長を正式に発表
item.description: ［３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［３日　ロイター］ - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）のピストンズが３日、制限付きフリーエージェント（ＦＡ）のセンター、ジェイレン・デューレン（２２）との契約延長を正式に発表した。

これまで米スポーツ専門チャンネルＥＳＰＮとジ・アスレチックは５年総額２億ドル（約３１６億円）と報じていたが、チームは契約の詳細を明かしていない。

ピストンズのバスケットボール運営部門代表を務めるトラジャン・ラングドン氏は「今後何年もジェイレンをチームの中心に据えられることをうれしく思う」とし、「彼は若くして多くを成し遂げており、われわれは彼の全盛期はこれからだと信じている」と述べた。

報道によると、ピストンズは最近デューレンに同じ総額２億ドルの契約を提示したものの、体重に関する条項を盛り込んでいたという。今回の合意では同条項が削除されたと報じられている。

昨季初めてオールスターとオールＮＢＡに選出されたデューレンは、レギュラーシーズンで自己最多の１試合平均１９．５得点に加え、１０．５リバウンドを記録。ピストンズは６０勝２２敗で東カンファレンス最高成績を残した。一方、プレーオフでは同１０．２得点、８．５リバウンドに数字を落とし、チームは東カンファレンス準決勝でキャバリアーズに３勝４敗で敗れた。

item.title: First-period goals hold up as Predators fend off Stars
item.description: First-period goals by Steven Stamkos and Nils Hoglander held up to the final buzzer as the host Nashville Predators claimed a 2-1 victory over the Dallas Stars on Saturday for their first win of the season.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: First-period goals by Steven Stamkos and Nils Hoglander held up to the final buzzer as the host Nashville Predators claimed a 2-1 victory over the Dallas Stars on Saturday for their first win of the season. Goaltender Juuse Saros made 29 saves -- 12 in the third period -- for the Predators, who rebounded after opening the campaign with a home loss to the Minnesota Wild on Thursday. Miro Heiskanen scored for the Stars, who have dropped two consecutive games to begin the season. Goalie Casey DeSmith stopped 24 shots and was denied the 100th victory of his career. With his team trailing after an early Dallas goal, Stamkos tied it on the power play when he unloaded a one-timer from the left faceoff dot set up by Ryan O'Reilly for the 625th goal of his career. Stamkos is tied with a pair of Hall of Fame luminaries in Joe Sakic -- one of his boyhood idols -- and Jarome Iginla for 17th on the NHL's all-time goals list. O'Reilly's assist was the 899th point of his career. The Predators carried the momentum and took the lead when Hoglander netted his first of the season by redirecting the point shot for another man-advantage tally at 15:49. Dallas regained its footing and pushed the rest of the way, but Saros held strong. Coming off a season-opening 4-0 loss to the visiting St. Louis Blues on Friday, the Stars were looking for a quick start and received it when Heiskanen opened the scoring 47 seconds into the clash by finishing a scramble. Nashville defenseman William Trudeau, claimed off waivers from the New York Rangers late last month, made his NHL debut. --Field Level Media

item.title: サッカー＝国際親善試合、ブラジルがインドに快勝 リノが初ゴール
item.description: ［コルカタ（インド） ３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［コルカタ（インド）　３日　ロイター］ - サッカーの国際親善試合が３日、各地で行われ、サムエウ・リノが代表初ゴールを決めたブラジルがアウェーでインドに４─０と快勝を収めた。

ブラジルは前半２８分、右サイドから切れ込んだエステバンがネットを揺らして先制し、さらに同４２分にはペドロのゴールもアシスト。後半１３分にリノが代表初得点を挙げると、試合終盤にリノが相手の守備をかわして自身この日２点目を記録した。

世界ランキング１３８位のインドは６戦連続で未勝利に。カルロ・アンチェロッティ監督率いるブラジルはオーストラリア戦も含めた遠征を２勝１分けとした。

item.title: Penguins relinquish 4-goal lead, recover to beat Canadiens in OT
item.description: Tommy Novak scored two goals, including the game-winner at 1:33 of overtime, and also had an assist to give the Pittsburgh Penguins a wild 6-5 victory over the visiting Montreal Canadiens on Saturday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Tommy Novak scored two goals, including the game-winner at 1:33 of overtime, and also had an assist to give the Pittsburgh Penguins a wild 6-5 victory over the visiting Montreal Canadiens on Saturday night. Evgeni Malkin, who finished with a goal and two assists, crossed a pass past Montreal defenseman Mike Matheson to Novak at the bottom of the right circle on a 2-on-1 break and Novak roofed a wrist shot over goaltender Jakub Dobes for the game-winner. Erik Karlsson and Kris Letang each had two assists and Ben Kindel, Declan Carlile and Samuel Girard also scored goals for Pittsburgh, which won despite blowing a 5-1 lead. Arturs Silovs made 20 saves. Sidney Crosby had an assist, the 1,109th of his career, moving him into a tie with Joe Thornton for seventh in NHL history. Nick Suzuki had a goal and three assists, Cole Caufield scored two goals, Chris Kreider and Ivan Demidov each had a goal and an assist and Lane Hutson chipped in with three assists for Montreal. Dobes finished with 24 saves. Montreal, which opened the season with a 3-2 victory at Toronto, jumped out to a 1-0 lead at the 3:49 mark of the first period when Caufield snapped a wrist shot from the right circle inside the far left post. Pittsburgh tied it on a power-play goal by Malkin, who chipped in a rebound of a Kris Letang shot for his second goal of the season.. The Penguins then scored four consecutive goals to start the second period to take a 5-1 lead. Carlile started the blitz 32 seconds into the period with a wrist shot from the top of the right circle that beat Dobes on his glove side. Girard followed when he roofed a backhand pass from Crosby from the low slot. Novak then finished a 2-on-1 rush with a wrist shot off an Egor Chinakov cross, and Kindel made it 5-1 with a power-play goal, redirecting a point shot by Karlsson into the top right corner of the net. Suzuki cut the lead to 5-2 just before the end of the period when he split a pair of defenders and fired a shot over Silovs' right shoulder. Caufield got his second goal of the game early in the third period with a wrist shot from the high slot to close the gap to two. The Canadiens then scored twice in the final 68 seconds to earn a point and force overtime, the first by Kreider and the second by Demidov off a Suzuki crossing pass with 44 seconds to go. --Field Level Media

item.title: Argentina golea 7-0 a Burkina Faso en partido amistoso
item.description: La selección de fútbol de Argentina exhibió el sábado su renovado poderío ofensivo, sin la presencia de Lionel Messi, al golear por 7-0 a Burkina Faso en un partido amistoso en el marco de la fecha FIFA.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La selección de fútbol de Argentina exhibió el sábado su renovado poderío ofensivo, sin la presencia de Lionel Messi, al golear por 7-0 a Burkina Faso en un partido amistoso en el marco de la fecha FIFA. Los goles del triunfo los anotaron Lautaro Martínez, Gianluca Prestiani, Nicolás Paz, Julián Álvarez, Giovani Simeone, Franco Mastantuono y Moumouni Daillo en contra de su propia valla. Argentina fue muy superior al joven seleccionado africano que arribó a Buenos Aires pocas horas antes del inicio del partido luego de afrontar dificultades logísticas con el viaje, de acuerdo a un comunicado de la organización. La "albiceleste" volverá a jugar el martes ante Benín en el estadio Monumental, en un partido con el que Messi se despedirá de la selección. El astro, que capitaneó a Argentina hacia la victoria en la Copa del Mundo de 2022 y la final de 2026, comunicó un mes atrás su retiro del equipo nacional luego de 19 años, pero sigue su carrera en Inter Miami. "Sabemos que se nos va Leo y ahora empieza todo un camino nuevo con chicos que se suman. Hay un gran grupo que se formó y seguiremos con la misma línea", dijo Enzo Fernández tras la goleada. En el partido disputado en el estadio Monumental, Argentina aprovechó una infracción innecesaria dentro del área para abrir el marcador a los cuatro minutos a través de Lautaro Martínez, al convertir en el rebote de un penal que le tapó el portero Razak Guira. Cuatro minutos después, otro error de Burkina Faso le permitió al conjunto dirigido por Lionel Scaloni ampliar la ventaja gracias a un gol de Moumouni Daillo en contra de su propia puerta tras un remate de Julián Álvarez. Antes del final de la primera parte, la "Albiceleste" anotó otros tres goles por intermedio de Gianluca Prestiani, Nicolás Paz y Julián Álvarez a los 24, 34 y 36 minutos, respectivamente. En el segundo tiempo, Argentina completó la goleada con tantos de Franco Mastantuono y Giuliano Simeone a los minutos 77 y 92. "Estoy muy contento de volverme a poner la camiseta de Argentina. Me quedé afuera del Mundial y fue triste, pero tenía que seguir trabajando para volver y hoy me tocó hacer un gol", dijo Mastantuono.

item.title: Islanders rout Devils in home-opening shutout
item.description: Simon Holmstrom, Brayden Schenn and Bo Horvat scored within a nine-minute span in the second period Saturday night and goalie Ilya Sorokin stopped all 37 shots he faced for the New York Islanders, who won their home opener by routing the New Jersey Devils 6-0.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Simon Holmstrom, Brayden Schenn and Bo Horvat scored within a nine-minute span in the second period Saturday night and goalie Ilya Sorokin stopped all 37 shots he faced for the New York Islanders, who won their home opener by routing the New Jersey Devils 6-0. Victor Eklund, Ondrej Palat and Casey Cizikas scored in the third for the Islanders, who bounced back from a 2-1 season-opening loss at Toronto. Reigning Calder Trophy winner Matthew Schaefer had two assists. The shutout for Sorokin was the franchise-record 30th of his career. Nico Daws made 26 saves for the Devils, who have also split their first two games. The Devils outshot the Islanders 9-7 in a scoreless first before the hosts took control into the second. Adam Pelech set up Holmstrom's goal by weaving through the neutral zone and dishing to Jean-Gabriel Pageau, who drew Daws to the right of the crease before dishing to Holmstrom. The winger then sent a shot over the right leg of the sprawling Daws at 3:32. A Devils turnover led to Schenn's goal just 88 seconds later. Schaefer picked off Stefan Noesen's pass just in front of the blue line and fired a shot that bounced off Daws. Eklund picked up the puck and sent a pass between his and Daws' legs to Schenn, who buried the point-blank chance. Schaefer collected another assist with 7:52 left in the second, when he fed Horvat at the front of the right faceoff circle before the Islanders captain directed a shot beyond Daws' glove. Eklund celebrated his 20th birthday by scoring his first NHL goal with 8:28 left in the third, when he got a stick on Calum Ritchie's pass and tucked a shot over Daws' glove. Palat added another insurance goal just 42 seconds later and Cizikas, in his 16th season with the Islanders, scored a short-handed goal with 1:19 left. --Field Level Media

item.title: Canes rally past Flyers in OT to secure first win of title defense
item.description: Shayne Gostisbehere scored a power-play goal in overtime to lift the Carolina Hurricanes to their first victory of the season with a 3-2 road win over the Philadelphia Flyers on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Shayne Gostisbehere scored a power-play goal in overtime to lift the Carolina Hurricanes to their first victory of the season with a 3-2 road win over the Philadelphia Flyers on Saturday. Gostisbehere's decisive goal was a one-timer from the top of the left circle at 2:51 of the extra session. The former Flyers defenseman benefited from a terrific screen from Andrei Svechnikov, who knocked down Philadelphia's Nick Seeler before impeding Joseph Woll's vision in front of the net. Pyotr Kochetkov made 16 saves to earn the win for Carolina, which had lost its first two contests of the young campaign. The defending champions' first two goals Saturday came courtesy of Sebastian Aho, including one 10 seconds into the contest. Owen Tippett and Matvei Michkov scored for Philadelphia, which was swept by Carolina in the Eastern Conference semifinals last season. Woll turned aside 37 shots for the hosts, who remain winless in three games this season. The game could not have gotten off to a better start for the Hurricanes, who promptly scored off the opening faceoff. William Carrier quickly centered the puck right past Flyers center Christian Dvorak and onto the stick of Aho, who snapped one past Woll. Philadelphia drew even at 8:03 of the first period as Tippett collected a loose puck in the high slot and buried a shot past Kochetkov. Michkov's first of the season gave the Flyers a 2-1 lead at 7:20 of the second period. However, Aho tied it at 2-2 early in the third period, as he scored a power-play goal from a similar spot to his first tally. This one came off a feed from Nikolaj Ehlers, setting up Aho's one-timer. The Flyers went on the power play late in regulation, but they struggled to enter the offensive zone. The man advantage carried over into overtime, when Tyson Foerster and Trevor Zegras had quality scoring chances, although Kochetkov held firm. Shortly thereafter, Carolina received a power play of its own when Tippett was whistled for slashing. With the Hurricanes skating 4-on-3, Svechnikov's one-timer was denied by Woll. However, Gostisbehere buried the game-winner less than a minute later. Philadelphia defenseman Rasmus Ristolainen left with an apparent hand injury. The team said he'll be further evaluated Sunday. --Field Level Media

item.title: Senators break tie in third, edge Leafs in season opener
item.description: Stephen Halliday scored the tiebreaking goal midway through the third period Saturday night and the visiting Ottawa Senators won their season opener, defeating the host Toronto Maple Leafs 3-2.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Stephen Halliday scored the tiebreaking goal midway through the third period Saturday night and the visiting Ottawa Senators won their season opener, defeating the host Toronto Maple Leafs 3-2. Newly appointed captain Thomas Chabot had a goal and assist and Michael Amadio also scored for Ottawa. Claude Giroux added two assists and Linus Ullmark stopped 27 shots. Auston Matthews and Kirill Marchenko scored for the Maple Leafs, who have lost two of their first three games, all at home. Sergei Bobrovsky made 26 saves for the Maple Leafs. The Maple Leafs hit both posts with shots in the first period. Teddy Blueger hit the left post at 13:28 on a redirect. Jack Roslovic hit the right post at 13:58. Ottawa scored the first goal when Chabot jumped up on the rush and knocked in a 12-footer off a rebound at 18:51 of the first period. Toronto tied the game 33 seconds into the second period on a tip-in by Matthews on Morgan Rielly's shot from the point. Marchenko flipped in a backhand shot on a pass from Darren Raddysh at 7:06 of the second on a power play. Giroux was off for slashing. Amadio tied the game at 12:40 of the second on a 2-on-1 counter with Tim Stutzle, who made a deft pass to the edge of the crease. Toronto had just been foiled on a rush. Halliday snapped in a five-footer at 9:46 of the third on a rebound to give Ottawa the lead. Toronto had a power-play chance at 14:20 of the third but did not get a shot on goal. Bobrovsky was pulled for an extra attacker with just under three minutes left in regulation. Matthews hit the post at 18:08. Bobrovsky had to return to the net after the Senators applied pressure. Ottawa defenseman Jake Sanderson did not return after the first period due to an undisclosed injury. --Field Level Media

item.title: Andrei Vasilevskiy sharp as Lightning beat Capitals
item.description: Reigning Vezina Trophy winner Andrei Vasilevskiy stopped 20 shots in his 600th career game, and the Tampa Bay Lightning won for the first time this season by topping the visiting Washington Capitals 3-1 on Saturday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Reigning Vezina Trophy winner Andrei Vasilevskiy stopped 20 shots in his 600th career game, and the Tampa Bay Lightning won for the first time this season by topping the visiting Washington Capitals 3-1 on Saturday night. Jake Guentzel had a goal and an assist, and Charle-Edouard D'Astous and Conor Geekie also found the net as Tampa Bay evened its record through two matches. Brandon Hagel had two assists. Justin Sourdif scored for the Capitals, who lost the second part of their weekend back-to-back set. Goaltender Charlie Lindgren made 27 saves for Washington, and teammate Dylan Strome skated in his 600th game. After losing 5-1 at the New York Rangers on Thursday in their season opener, the Lightning needed less than 2 1/2 minutes to strike for their initial home goal. D'Astous sent in a shot near the right circle that beat Lindgren for the defenseman's first tally. While Tampa Bay's power play went 0-for-7 in the opening defeat, it clicked early on the match's first man advantage when Sourdif went off for holding at 8:35. Though it did not find the net, the unit put plenty of pressure on Lindgren and had close chances. As D'Astous did, Geekie ripped a shot that smoked Lindgren high on the left side to increase the lead to two goals at 16:30 as the club dominated by leading 14-5 in shots in the first period. Following a 5-2 win at the defending Stanley Cup champion Carolina Hurricanes on Friday, the Capitals found their footing in the second, answered with a goal and matched Tampa Bay with seven shots. Sourdif trimmed Washington's deficit in half at 7:04 after a turnover in the neutral zone. He raced toward the net and chipped in Jakob Chychrun's pass from the blue line for his first goal. The teams skated 4-on-4 early in the third after Tom Wilson and Zemgus Girgensons roughed each other behind Vasilevskiy, but the Lightning had a crucial penalty kill in the middle portion to help preserve the lead. With the net empty and just over two minutes remaining, Guentzel took a pass from Nikita Kucherov and iced the win. --Field Level Media

item.title: Leon Draisaitl's deciding goal lifts Oilers past Kraken
item.description: Leon Draisaitl scored the tiebreaking goal with 2:27 remaining to give the Edmonton Oilers a 3-1 victory against the visiting Seattle Kraken on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Leon Draisaitl scored the tiebreaking goal with 2:27 remaining to give the Edmonton Oilers a 3-1 victory against the visiting Seattle Kraken on Saturday. Connor McDavid added an empty-net goal with 1:05 left to clinch the victory. Owen Michaels also scored for the Oilers and goaltender Devon Levi made 19 saves as the Oilers won their second straight after a season-opening 6-5 overtime loss to visiting Vancouver. Bobby McMann tallied for the Kraken and Philipp Grubauer stopped 22 of 24 shots. The deciding goal came after McDavid sent a pass back to defenseman Ryan Shea at the left point. Shea, with his back to the net, banked the puck high off the boards to keep it in the offensive zone. The puck floated through the slot untouched until it reached Draisaitl outside the top right edge of the crease and he quickly put it past Grubauer. The Oilers took a 1-0 lead in the first period while outshooting the Kraken 10-5. Alex Formenton forced a turnover along the boards in the Seattle end and fed a backhanded pass to Michaels deep on the left wing. The rookie lifted a one-timer over Grubauer's shoulder and into the near upper corner of the net at 2:51. It was Michaels' second goal in as many games after also tallying in Thursday's 9-7 victory at Vancouver. Seattle tied it with a power-play goal in the second, when it had an 11-4 edge in shots. Jordan Eberle got the puck behind the Edmonton net and fed McMann in the lower inside corner of the left faceoff circle. McMann put a shot into the near upper corner of the net, beating Levi at 9:06. The Oilers, who led the NHL on the power play last season by converting 30.6% of their attempts, were held scoreless on three attempts with the man advantage by the Kraken, who were 31st of 32 teams last season on the penalty kill at 72.2%. Edmonton remained without four of its top seven forwards with Ryan Nugent-Hopkins (lower body), Jason Dickinson (undisclosed), Zach Hyman (undisclosed) and Matt Savoie (undisclosed) all injured. Forward Mackie Samoskevich made his Kraken debut after being activated off injured reserve (upper body) earlier in the day, with fellow forward Jacob Melanson going on the IR with an upper-body injury suffered in the season opener, a 6-1 victory Thursday at Calgary. --Field Level Media

item.title: USA/MIDTERMS-Trump tente de mobiliser les électeurs dans l'Ohio
item.description: Le président américain Donald Trump a adopté un ton combatif lors d'un rassemblement organisé samedi dans l'Ohio, l'un des Etats où le scrutin pour remporter un siège au Sénat lors des élections de mi-mandat pourrait être décisif.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le président américain Donald Trump a adopté un ton combatif lors d'un rassemblement organisé samedi dans l'Ohio, l'un des Etats où le scrutin pour remporter un siège au Sénat lors des élections de mi-mandat pourrait être décisif. "Allez simplement voter", a dit le président républicain lors d'un rassemblement en soutien aux candidats de son parti aux postes de sénateur, Jon Husted, et de gouverneur, Vivek Ramaswamy. "Si vous y allez, on va gagner, on va remporter une large victoire, et on va leur en faire voir de toutes les couleurs." De nombreux sénateurs républicains sortants à travers le pays sont confrontés à de rudes vents contraires sur le plan politique, alors que la popularité de Donald Trump a chuté ces derniers mois en raison de l'augmentation du coût de la vie et de la guerre en Iran. Les sondages suggèrent que les démocrates pourraient gagner du terrain lors des élections du 3 novembre, mais Donald Trump a affirmé que les républicains feraient mieux que ne le prévoient leurs détracteurs. "Je pense que nous allons leur réserver une grosse surprise, car ils ne savent pas ce qu'il se passe", a-t-il déclaré à la foule rassemblée à Vandalia, dans l'Ohio. Le sénateur républicain Jon Husted, nommé à ce siège en 2025 après la démission de J.D. Vance devenu vice-président, fait face à l'ancien sénateur démocrate Sherrod Brown, qui espère que les électeurs de l'Ohio se souviendront de son long parcours marqué par un populisme économique assumé alors qu'il tente de retrouver son siège. Donald Trump a recueilli plus de 55% des voix dans l'Ohio lors de l'élection présidentielle de 2024. L'Ohio fait partie des Etats où le [USN:L8N4500SK TEXT:"scrutin"] est considéré comme véritablement compétitifs pour remporter un siège au Sénat. Voir aussi: LE POINT sur les élections de mi-mandat du 3 novembre aux Etats-Unis ([USN:L8N4560J1 TEXT:"Full Story"])

item.title: Cornell president vows 'serious look' at fraternities, sororities in wake of rape allegations
item.description: Cornell University will examine the role of fraternities and sororities on campus following an outcry over the school's handling of a student's rape allegations, the Ivy League school's president said on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Cornell University will examine the role of fraternities and sororities on campus following an outcry over the school's handling of a student's rape allegations, the Ivy League school's president said on Saturday. A [USN:L1N45O0OO TEXT:"civil lawsuit"] filed last month by the woman, who alleges she was drugged and raped in 2024 by several members of the Chi Phi fraternity, has sparked [USN:L6N45O0CP TEXT:"outrage and soul-searching"] at Cornell over its campus culture at the school in Ithaca, New York. In a video message, Cornell University President Michael Kotlikoff said the school would take steps to prevent a similar situation in the future. That includes "a serious look at the role of fraternities and sororities in campus life," Kotlikoff said. "At their best, these organizations can provide students with friendship, belonging, mentorship and a powerful sense of community," he said. "But being part of a group can never diminish individual responsibility." The university will seek input, he said, from students, alumni and others on how to "preserve what is valuable about Greek life while strengthening individual accountability, transparency and a culture in which every member understands their responsibility to protect the safety and well-being of others." The lawsuit against Cornell, seven fraternity members and others, alleges that the school failed to adequately punish some of the accused students. The accused men have denied all wrongdoing, the New York Times reported. Cornell has defended its handling of the matter, saying it launched a comprehensive investigation and barred the Chi Phi fraternity from campus. The school said it imposed a range of disciplinary measures, including expulsions. But "we must do better," Kotlikoff said. "We don’t have all the answers, but we are committed to investigating and finding the answers our community deserves." He vowed that university officials would "be more transparent" about their actions related to the 2024 incident, but he did not detail specific initiatives that the university would take. "In the coming weeks, we will create additional opportunities for members of our community to ask questions and hear directly from university leadership," he said. The case has reignited scrutiny of how law enforcement and universities handle sexual assault complaints, with students questioning whether processes are enough to protect them. It has also drawn the attention of New York state officials, who have appointed a special prosecutor to investigate.

item.title: Jiri Kulich's third-period goal lifts Sabres past winless Blackhawks
item.description: After missing most of last season with a blood clot, Jiri Kulich scored the game-winning goal with 6:40 remaining in regulation to propel the Buffalo Sabres to a 4-3 victory in their home opener over the Chicago Blackhawks on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: After missing most of last season with a blood clot, Jiri Kulich scored the game-winning goal with 6:40 remaining in regulation to propel the Buffalo Sabres to a 4-3 victory in their home opener over the Chicago Blackhawks on Saturday. Tage Thompson tallied a goal and an assist, and Jack Quinn and Rasmus Dahlin also scored for the Sabres, while Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen made 12 saves in the victory. Ryan Donato, Tyler Bertuzzi and Oliver Moore scored for the Blackhawks. Anton Frondell and Alex Vlasic finished with two assists apiece, while Spencer Knight stopped 24 of the 28 shots he faced as Chicago opened its season with three straight losses. Donato started the scoring just under eight minutes into the game as he took a pass from Vlasic and fired a shot past Luukkonen to give the Blackhawks the early lead. Chicago doubled the lead with 8:36 left in the first period after Frondell slid a cross-crease pass to Bertuzzi, who tapped it into the open net. Quinn deked past a defender and then found Dahlin for a one-timer opportunity, but Knight kicked out the pad to deny the attempt with just over five minutes remaining in the first. Quinn got another chance minutes later as he burned past a defending player and unloaded a powerful wrist shot that found the back of the net with 16:24 gone in the period. Thompson knotted the game with his first goal of the young season as he tipped Louis Crevier's point shot past Knight with 14:19 left in the second. Frank Nazar went on a short-handed breakaway with just over three minutes remaining in the middle frame, but Luukkonen got just enough of Nazar's five-hole shot to force it wide of the net. Seconds after the penalty expired, Moore stepped out of the box, took a pass from Frondell and snuck it past Luukkonen to give the Blackhawks the 3-2 advantage with 18:18 expired in the period. Peyton Krebs led the counterattack into the Blackhawks' end and sent a pass to Dahlin, who quickly wired it past Knight to knot up the contest at three apiece with 13:50 left in the third period. Quinn looked to build upon his impressive night as he stormed toward the Blackhawks' net with 11:46 left, but Knight shut the door on the young speedster. Kulich notched his first goal of the season for the 4-3 edge on assists from Owen Power and Thompson. --Field Level Media

item.title: Ｆ１＝バーレーンＧＰ予選、フェルスタッペンが今季初ＰＰ
item.description: ［３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［３日　ロイター］ - 自動車レースＦ１の第１６戦、バーレーン・グランプリ（ＧＰ）は３日、マレーシアのセパンで予選を行い、個人総合優勝４回を誇るマックス・フェルスタッペン（オランダ、レッドブル）が今季自身初のポールポジション（ＰＰ）を獲得した。

フェルスタッペンは１分３５秒１３０をマーク。２番手のルイス・ハミルトン（英国、フェラーリ）を０秒２９８上回った。フェルスタッペンの同僚、アイザック・ハジャー（フランス）が３番手に入ったが、パワーユニットのコンポーネント交換で、決勝では５グリッド降格のペナルティーを受ける。

総合首位のキミ・アントネッリ（イタリア、メルセデス）は４番手でシャルル・ルクレール（モナコ、フェラーリ）が５番手。ランド・ノリス（英国）が６番手、オスカー・ピアストリ（オーストラリア）が７番手とマクラーレン勢が続き、総合２位のジョージ・ラッセル（英国、メルセデス）は８番手に終わった。

中東情勢を受けて、今大会はマレーシアで開催されている。

item.title: Australia's Treasurer heads to Japan for inaugural finance ministerial forum
item.description: Australian Treasurer Jim Chalmers said he will travel to Japan on Sunday for talks with his Japanese counterpart in the first of an annual forum aiming to bolster bilateral ties.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Australian Treasurer Jim Chalmers said he will travel to Japan on Sunday for talks with his Japanese counterpart in the first of an annual forum aiming to bolster bilateral ties. The main purpose of the inaugural Australia-Japan Finance Ministerial Dialogue would be to discuss "investment opportunities, strategic financing and international engagement more broadly", Chalmers said in a statement. He would seek to progress a deal with Japan's finance minister, Satsuki Katayama, to boost investment cooperation, the statement said. Japan was Australia's fourth-largest foreign investor in 2024, with total investments valued at A$282.9 billion ($196.7 billion), according to the government. The two countries face "many similar challenges as a result of global uncertainty, whether it’s higher energy prices driving up inflation or higher bond yields that are putting pressure on our budgets", the treasurer added. While in Japan, Chalmers said he would also meet more than 30 CEOs and business leaders to showcase Australia as a "premier investment destination". ($1 = 1.4382 Australian dollars)

FAST

India and Pakistan summoned each other's top diplomats on Saturday (Oct 3) over a border incident on Friday, with New Delhi rejecting Islamabad's allegation that Indian forces had killed two unarmed Pakistani civilians and saying those involved had crossed illegally into Indian territory.

Pakistan's foreign ministry said earlier on Saturday that personnel from India's Border Security Force had used "unprovoked lethal force" against two unarmed Pakistani civilians in the Bedian sector along the international border on Friday.

"Pakistan categorically rejects any attempt to mischaracterize the deceased as 'infiltrators'," the ministry said in a statement.

Pakistan said it had summoned India's chargé d'affaires to lodge a protest over the incident and called for an "immediate, transparent and credible investigation".

India's foreign ministry later rejected what it called "baseless and motivated allegations" and said it had summoned the chargé d'affaires of the Pakistan High Commission to protest at the "continued facilitation of illegal cross-border infiltration from Pakistan".

The ministry said three people had crossed into Indian territory in the Ferozepur sector of Punjab and continued moving towards the border fence despite multiple warnings from the BSF to return to Pakistan.

"The BSF was compelled to engage them for posing an imminent security threat," the ministry said.

India said the incident reflected "a clear pattern of repeated cross-border movement by armed narcotics syndicates operating from Pakistan" and urged Islamabad to investigate what it described as cross-border infiltration and drug-smuggling activities.

India also urged Pakistan to respect the international border, observe bilateral arrangements and ensure its forces prevented unauthorised movement from its side.

Relations between the two nuclear-armed rivals have been strained since a four-day war in 2025, the worst in decades, followed by a militant attack on tourists in Indian Kashmir that killed 26 people.

New Delhi accused Pakistan of backing the attack, which Islamabad denied.

Related:

One year after India-Pakistan clash, a fragile truce holds amid rising risks

Source: Reuters/ia
